findings.title: Compute runs on demand: 0% covered by commitments
findings.evidence: 908.09 USD of on-demand commitment-eligible compute in October. Advisor's best commitment option: 200.00 USD a month (1 year).
findings.action: Review Advisor's reservation and savings plan options with finance before buying; choose one of them, not both.

findings.title: 100% of the cost misses at least one allocation tag (costcenter, owner, environment)
findings.evidence: 5,051.32 USD of 5,051.32 USD in October.
findings.action: Tag the resource groups listed under Allocation readiness, starting with rg-network-hubs-eus, or enable tag inheritance in Cost Management.

findings.title: Resource group MC_rg-aks-prod_aks-prod-swc_swedencentral grew +100% month over month
findings.evidence: 368.14 USD in September → 734.49 USD in October (+366.35 USD).
findings.action: Confirm the growth is planned with the owner of MC_rg-aks-prod_aks-prod-swc_swedencentral; if not, find the resources behind it in Top resources.

findings.title: Forecast over budget: budget-contoso-monthly
findings.evidence: 1,805.99 USD spent and 4,784.60 USD forecast against 3,750.00 USD (Monthly).
findings.action: Review the drivers in What changed and agree a correction or a new amount with the budget owner.

findings.title: Resource group rg-aks-prod grew +100% month over month
findings.evidence: 120.63 USD in September → 241.12 USD in October (+120.50 USD).
findings.action: Confirm the growth is planned with the owner of rg-aks-prod; if not, find the resources behind it in Top resources.

findings.title: Service Virtual Machines grew +45% month over month
findings.evidence: 527.34 USD in September → 764.08 USD in October (+236.74 USD).
findings.action: Confirm the growth is planned with the owner of Virtual Machines; if not, find the resources behind it in Top resources.

findings.title: Unusual cost on 28 Oct 2026
findings.evidence: 204.50 USD against a typical 162.56 USD (+26%), driven by Foundry Tools +42.58 USD.
findings.action: Check what started on that day for Foundry Tools (deployments, scale-out, data transfer) and confirm it is expected.
